Telescope 3.1.2 makes both apps safer to use. Update the phone app and the desktop together.

- **Local only now really means local only.** With it on, your camera can only be started over the USB cable, never over Wi-Fi.
- **Windows: a safer camera driver.** The driver now lives in Program Files, where other programs can't tamper with it. If you set it up with an older version, open **Advanced** and click **Reinstall** once. Your camera keeps working until you do.
- **Linux: your settings stay yours.** Other accounts on the same computer can't read your Telescope settings or your virtual mic's audio anymore.
- **Pairing is harder to disrupt.** While **Add phone** is open, other devices on your network can't jam it.

Also fixed: on Windows, a driver install that failed could still say "Installed".

Found something broken? Open an issue and paste your **Copy diagnostics** report into it.
